claim_ceiling: Owner receipt conformance and hard-gate aggregation only; not an industrial site selection, production-network simulation, routing, utility engineering, or consent determination.

semantics.receipt_identity: Every receipt must match the required owner, contract, revision, comparison scope, candidate subject and current evidence state.
semantics.hard_gate: A current explicit Fail on any hard gate makes the alternative Infeasible; this cannot be compensated by another dimension.
semantics.unknown: Missing, stale, revoked, unknown, wrong-owner, wrong-contract, wrong-revision, wrong-scope or wrong-subject evidence is Unknown; it never becomes Pass.
semantics.algorithm_boundary: The adapter does not recompute capability closure, inventory, resource balances, routes, access or site suitability. It consumes exact owner-native outcomes.

cases.description: All eight required owner evidence dimensions are current and pass.
A current land-rights receipt explicitly fails its hard gate.
Land-rights evidence is stale and therefore unknown.
A required supplier-dependency receipt is missing.
Utility capacity is explicitly insufficient.
Worker-access evidence is unknown for the declared shift/group.
Freight deliverability fails for the vehicle and delivery window.
Revoked material qualification cannot be promoted to current.
A non-empty but incorrect owner source revision is unknown.
A receipt bound to another comparison scope is unknown.
A receipt bound to another candidate subject is unknown.
A receipt asserted by the wrong owner is unknown.
A receipt from a different owner contract is unknown.
Candidate scope differs from the shared comparison scope.
A known hard-gate failure takes precedence over another unknown dimension.
One missing source receipt leaves the candidate unknown.
Duplicate requirement dimension identifiers make the case unsupported.
Reusing one owner receipt ID across dimensions is unsupported.
A receipt for an undeclared dimension is unsupported.
Duplicate alternative IDs make the case unsupported.
Reordering dimensions, alternatives and receipts does not alter the canonical result.
A supplier-network owner reports shared single-source dependency, so the hard gate fails.
An owner receipt with no source revision remains unknown.
A syntactically valid owner receipt explicitly reports unknown evidence.
